title: How strong is Magnus Carlsen, really?

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Magnus Carlsen once played ten people at once, with his back to every single board.
phrases.say: [serious] Magnus Carlsen once played ten people at once... with his back to every single board.

phrases.text: And that's not even the scariest part.
phrases.say: And that's not even the scariest part.

phrases.text: At five, he knew every country on Earth: the flag, the capital, the population.
phrases.say: At five, he knew every country on Earth. The flag... the capital... the population.

phrases.text: At thirteen, he was a grandmaster, and he faced Garry Kasparov, the world number one.
phrases.say: At thirteen, he was a grandmaster... and he faced Garry Kasparov. The world number one.

phrases.text: Mid-game, while Kasparov was thinking, Magnus just stood up and wandered off, like he was bored.
phrases.say: Mid-game, while Kasparov was thinking... Magnus just stood up, and wandered off. [amused] Like he was bored.

phrases.text: The game ended in a draw.
phrases.say: The game ended in a draw.

phrases.text: In 2021, the computer said dead draw for fifteen moves.
phrases.say: In twenty twenty-one, the computer said: dead draw. For fifteen moves.

phrases.text: Magnus kept pushing, and won in 136 moves. The longest game in world championship history.
phrases.say: Magnus kept pushing... and won. In a hundred thirty-six moves. The longest game in world championship history.

phrases.text: His peak rating, 2882, is the highest ever.
phrases.say: His peak rating, twenty-eight eighty-two, is the highest ever.

phrases.text: In classical chess, Magnus has beaten Hikaru fourteen times. Hikaru has beaten him once.
phrases.say: In classical chess, Magnus has beaten Hikaru fourteen times. Hikaru has beaten him... once.

phrases.text: And he's been world number one for fifteen years straight.
phrases.say: And he's been world number one... for fifteen years straight.

phrases.text: From 2018 to 2020, he didn't lose a single classical game. 125 in a row.
phrases.say: From twenty eighteen to twenty twenty, he didn't lose a single classical game. [impressed] A hundred twenty-five in a row.

phrases.text: So how many moves would you last against him? Comment below.
phrases.say: So... how many moves would you last against him? Comment below.
